title: BE OF GOOD
COURAGE
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: soft sunlight streaming onto a wooden desk
dust motes dancing in midday sunbeam
empty chair in warm sunlit room
still midday shadows on a white wall
peaceful garden view in high noon light

scenes.a: That recurring doubt about your capability is exactly why you need this midday stillness now.
Listen to the word of the Lord as it is written in Psalm 31:24.
Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
Father, grant me the grace to set aside my own limited perspective and trust your promise.
May your internal resolve be renewed as you lean into the quiet strength of God today.
Walk forward in the confidence that he is sustaining your spirit through this afternoon and beyond.
